'''Fluid Tank''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility for storing fluids.|It took the engineers nearly 5 years to come up with a tank that can store corrosive fluids while being resistant against the effects of ambient Blight.}}
==Usage==
A facility for storing up to 500 unit of a type of fluid.

*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Fluid Storage]]
